$comment: The AndroidX A2UI release vendored under vendor/ and ported to Compose Multiplatform.
Published versions are immutable and use <release>-cmp<portRevision>; bump portRevision
whenever this repository changes the published port without moving to a newer release.
The sources are the release's own -sources.jars, not androidx-main: see vendor/README.md.
